_comment: Baseline sector risk profiles for Indian mid-market lending. These are analyst-maintained reference data, not model output: update last_reviewed when the view changes. risk_points is a 0-20 headwind score; scoring.py applies half of it as a Conditions penalty. regulatory_risk drives the sector regulatory alert card.
